Navi is hiring for the role of Debt Management Executive II – NSA!

Responsibilities of the Candidate:

  • Ensure successful collections and achieve performance targets.
  • Communicate the consequences of loan repayment defaults to customers in a clear and professional manner.
  • Manage delinquent customer accounts.
  • Ensure adherence to collection processes, compliance standards, and quality guidelines.

Requirements:

  • 12th Grade education or a bachelor's degree
  • Prior experience in collections is mandatory, with a minimum of 6 months
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; observant and presentable.
  • Basic knowledge of internet browsing and search engine usage.
  • Proficiency in Hindi is mandatory. Knowledge of additional languages will be an added advantage.
  • DRA certification (preferred, not mandatory).

BrowserStack is hiring for the role of Sales Development Representative!

Responsibilities of the Candidate:

  • To identify and hunt prospects through inbound motion & prospecting.

  • To complete a volume of calls and emails to prospects (in the territory) on a daily basis.

  • Call and email on new prospects and develop business relationships with the associations.

  • Serve as the first in-depth point of contact to prospective partners and customers.

  • Provide product information to prospective customers.

  • Demonstrate solution-selling and relationship-building skills.

  • To communicate/position/sell our value proposition to prospects.

  • To secure an assigned number of sales appointments (webinars, in person meetings, event participation, etc).

  • Responsible for documenting all calls and email activities on the CRM system.

Requirements:

  • 5 months - 2 years of Sales/Business Development experience with B2B corporate sales experience.

  • Fluent in English - written and spoken with a passion for technology.

  • Strong sense of initiative and personal leadership, self- starter.

  • Strong business acumen, ethics and high integrity.

  • Excel at developing relationships over the phone.

  • Must be organised, articulate and detail-oriented with the ability to multitask in a dynamic, fast-changing environment.

  • Data-driven, results-oriented and an outstanding team player who collaborates and plays to win.

{"id": 1724812, "public_url": "jobs/wordpress-engineer-browserstack-1724812", "title": "Wordpress Engineer", "organization_id": 113683, "type": "jobs", "subtype": "jobs", "regn_open": 0, "moderation_status": 1, "self_moderated": 2, "updated_at": "2026-07-25T16:27:21+05:30", "region": "online", "created_at": "2026-07-25T00:47:27+05:30", "visibility": "public", "details": "

BrowserStack is hiring for the role of Wordpress Engineer!

Responsibilities of the Candidate:

  • Develop and maintain WordPress themes, templates, and plugins
  • Convert designs/wireframes into responsive, production-ready pages
  • Build reusable, clean, and maintainable front-end components
  • Integrate APIs and third-party tools
  • Fix bugs and improve performance, accessibility, and SEO
  • Participate in code reviews and follow engineering best practices
  • Collaborate with design, marketing, and product teams to ship features quickly
  • Continuously learn and grow under mentorship from senior engineers

Requirements:

  • 1–3 years of experience building websites or web applications
  • Strong fundamentals in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
  • Working knowledge of PHP and WordPress basics (themes, plugins, CMS workflows)
  • Experience building responsive, mobile-first web pages
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and data formats (JSON/XML)
  • Basic understanding of authentication/authorization concepts
  • Hands-on with Git for version control
  • Knowledge of MySQL or relational databases
  • Good debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Strong learning mindset with good communication and collaboration skills
